purpose: National V4: evaluation, error analysis and the fixed relative colour contract of the ACCEPTED notebook-20 selection; no training, no reselection, no serving, no 2026 data

inputs.province_names_note: display names only (province_code -> name_en / name_th) for report labels; never a predictor, group key or metric input; sha256 recorded in inputs.csv

colour.density_definition: expected SELECTED+LINKED retained MOT recorded count for the same target horizon (one local day, or one 6 h block) divided by the qualified DOH segment geom_length_m / 1000 (km); records per km per horizon period
colour.reference: selected policy full-population 2022-23 OOF cells, unweighted (each segment x period cell counts once), separately per unit
colour.quantile_method: numpy.quantile method='linear' (Hyndman-Fan type 7) on float64 densities
colour.assignment: band index = number of raw cutoffs strictly below the density (density equal to a cutoff stays in the lower band); duplicate cutoffs therefore collapse deterministically and the skipped labels are simply unused (never forced)

accessible_text.base: Lower relative predicted recorded density (below the median reference cell). NOT safe and NOT an accident probability.
accessible_text.yellow: Above-median relative predicted recorded density (50th-80th percentile of reference cells).
accessible_text.orange: High relative predicted recorded density (80th-95th percentile of reference cells).
accessible_text.red: Highest relative predicted recorded density (top 5% of reference cells). Relative ranking only, not an absolute risk.
accessible_text.grey: Unavailable: unsupported segment, missing/invalid prediction or length, or a horizon without a contract.

colour.limitations: Relative to the 2022-23 OOF reference of recorded+linked records on the current DOH road snapshot; reflects recording, selection and linkage, not physical crash frequency or per-vehicle exposure. Cutoffs are fixed across routes and viewports and are never converted between horizons.

capture.tie_break: stable sort by descending density, ties by ascending segment index
capture.boundary: the boundary segment contributes the fraction of its length inside the budget; its actual records are allocated proportionally to that length fraction (disclosed assumption)

manager_reference.note: national V4: gate figures copied from the verified notebook-20 run (Claude review). floor_group_gain_share was not pre-computed nationally; the soft check reports "differs" with the recomputed value.
